items.description: An entry in a transcript's timeline, including server-managed fields.

kind.description:
`line`: something said or typed. `gap`: a stretch where nothing was
captured — a dropped connection, a provider failure. `pause`: the
conversation off the record, by choice.

startedAt.description: When it began, by the client's clock. Entries are in this order.

endedAt.description: When it ended, by the client's clock. Null only for a pause still going on.

text.description: What was said or typed. Lines only.

speaker.description:
Who said a line, as a role. A contract set replaces these by overlay —
safety-net-contracts might say `worker` and `applicant`.

speakerLabel.description: The transcription service's own label for the speaker, e.g. `spk_0` or `ch_1`, kept so a mapping mistake can be corrected. Lines only.

confidence.description: The transcription service's confidence in the line. Spoken lines only.

cause.description: Why nothing was captured, as far as the client knows.

createdAt.description: When the entry was recorded, by the server's clock.

updatedAt.description: When the entry last changed, by the server's clock.

transcript.description: Link to the related Transcript resource.

offset.description: Number of entries skipped before this page.

hasNext.description: Whether more entries are available beyond this page.
